integrity: The sharp minimax result is supported by a self-contained analytic proof; finite checker assertions are supplemental and do not prove all real parameter cases. Prior noise-horizon and algorithm results are explicitly credited.
limitations: Exact one-dimensional free subspace, deterministic bounded right-hand-side errors, fixed independent row sampling, exact projections. No higher-dimensional, adaptive-filtering, or finite-precision guarantee.
title: Sharp minimax moment frontier for one-free-coordinate norm-weighted Kaczmarz
